title: Microsoft Purview: eDiscovery – Enhancement of Loop and Copilot Pages in Review and Export
description: Improves eDiscovery workflows for Loop and Copilot pages by enabling full indexing of page content for keyword search within review sets and adding HTML format support for export from search.
